decisions.reason: A burner component for the core radiant heater line costs little to keep, and its value is still uncertain while the gas-to-hydrogen shift plays out, so the option stays open.
The electric infrared panel heater has its own page and suits the electrification push after the 2023 heating debate; demand is still uncertain, so keeping this low-cost option open is sensible.
The halogen infrared heater widens the electric portfolio at modest cost, and one year of results is too little to show it lacks value, so it stays on the market.
The industrial electric hall heater fits the firm's core market of hall heating and hedges against decarbonization pressure on gas, so it is a valuable option to keep.

The hydrogen-capable dark radiator is a strategic option on future hydrogen infrastructure, and its first real-world installation is a positive signal, so the firm keeps it while uncertainty resolves.
